data: Apple's fiscal 2024 ended on September 28, 2024. For that year it reported total net sales of about $391.0 billion, up roughly 2% from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was about $93.7 billion, down about 3% from $97.0 billion the prior year, which included a one-time income tax charge of roughly $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission State Aid decision. Total assets at fiscal year-end stood at about $364.98 billion, compared with $352.6 billion at the end of fiscal 2023. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's 10-K filing, so please confirm them against the filing on the SEC's EDGAR site if you need exact numbers.
